title: file-browser: universal file-open dialog with source-provider adapters (open any file; localhost-only)

decisions.text: Adapter architecture in TS/Bun (owner agreed 2026-07-12). A FileSourceProvider interface { id, listRoots(), listDir(path, opts), stat(path), openStream(path) } with a server-side provider registry; the UI selects a provider by id. LocalFsProvider (Bun node:fs/promises) ships first. Remote/DB/web providers are dropped from scope (FB-D15) but the architecture still allows them later as additional ids behind the same UI without a rewrite. FPC-CLI REJECTED: Bun is already the filesystem data-plane (readdir/stat/realpath over WS) and a self-contained per-host agent; the repo's FPC cli/ is a DSP engine and AppMain.exe is a webview host, not a file service. FPC would add a second language + new IPC for a capability Bun already has.

Security = localhost-only, via a SEPARATE 127.0.0.1 bind (owner choice 2026-07-12). The file-browse endpoints (fs.*) listen on their OWN loopback-only socket bound to 127.0.0.1, not reachable over the LAN — chosen over per-message remote-address checks for a harder guarantee that doesn't depend on proxy-forwarded addresses. This replaces the single-root isPathInsideBase sandbox (audio-file-utils.ts:62-90) for the local provider: full-machine read, but only from localhost. Path canonicalization (realpath) is kept to avoid symlink/traversal surprises. The main server keeps serving UI/other endpoints to LAN clients as before; only file-browse is loopback-locked. Transport = HTTP REST on this loopback server (GET /fs/roots, /fs/list, /fs/stat) — chosen over WS since a separate bind is naturally a second Bun.serve and it matches the existing audio HTTP endpoints. The main server exposes GET /api/fs/info (loopback-detected via server.requestIP) so the UI discovers the loopback URL + availability; remote clients get available:false and cannot reach the bind anyway. CORS is permissive on the loopback server (safe: only same-machine browsers can reach it). Remote sources get their own auth as separate providers later.

OS-specific roots, OS-agnostic UI (owner req. 3, 2026-07-12). Provider.listRoots() is OS-aware: Windows -> drive letters (C:\, D:\, ...) plus known folders (Desktop/Documents/home); POSIX -> '/' (plus home and mounted volumes). The UI NEVER hardcodes 'drives' — it renders whatever listRoots() returns as top-level entries (label+icon) and navigates over opaque path strings from the provider. All Windows-vs-unix difference lives inside the provider; the dialog is identical on every OS.

Three view modes (owner req. 5, 2026-07-12): (a) linear LIST — names only, dense; (b) ICONS — small/medium/large sizes; (c) TABLE 'Total Commander style' — columns name/ext/size/mtime/attributes, each column sortable in both directions. View mode + last sort are a persisted UI preference (localStorage). FsEntry carries {name, path, isDir, isSymlink, size, mtimeMs, ext, kind} so all three views + all sort keys work from one payload.

Quick regexp filter, TC Ctrl-S style (owner req. 6, 2026-07-12). An incremental filter box narrows the visible list live as the user types; matches against the entry name. Regexp by default (case-insensitive, toggleable); an invalid regexp falls back to a literal substring match (no error spam). Esc clears the filter and restores the full list. Filtering is client-side over the already-loaded dir payload.

Performance & sorting (owner req. 7, 2026-07-12). listDir returns the full dir payload with metadata (name/isDir/size/mtime/ext) in one pass via readdir({withFileTypes}) + batched stat; sort & filter run client-side for typical dirs, with q-virtual-scroll for large ones. Provider.listDir(opts) reserves optional server-side sort+paginate params for huge dirs (100k+) as a later optimization — not built up front. Directories sort before files by default; sort is stable.

Coexists with the preset browser during migration (owner choice 2026-07-12, REVISED). The universal dialog is invoked from a classic menu bar (File -> Open, FB-D8); the old presetsRoot q-tree STAYS in place for now — the dialog is added beside it, not a replacement yet (full retirement is a later migration step). presetsRoot survives as the dialog's default/initial location. The editor's open path reuses resolveAllowedAudioFilePath's kind-detection, but path authorization shifts from single-root to the loopback bind + canonicalize (FB-D2). Favorites are in scope (FB-D10); image thumbnails are future (Phase 4).

Classic menu bar INSIDE the Audio page (owner req. 9 + placement choice 2026-07-12: 'the audio tab must be self-contained, so the menu lives in it'). A classic-style menu bar sits at the top of the Audio page content card (above the Player/Editor tabs), NOT in the global MainLayout header. A File menu with an Open item invokes the universal dialog. Further menu items (recent/etc.) can follow; this is where the migration off the q-tree eventually lands. NOTE: scope revised by FB-D12 — the bar moves up to span the whole Audio form (over the side panels too) in Phase 4 (FB4.1).

Editor-supported type filter (owner req. 1 clarified, 2026-07-12). The dialog lists ONLY editor-supported files by default — audio/gnaural extensions (.gnaural/.wav/.flac via getAudioFileKind); directories are always shown for navigation. The provider still walks the whole filesystem; the type filter is applied to the file listing (a filetype dropdown may expose 'all files' later, but the default and primary mode is supported-types-only).

Loopback must never be proxied (owner: 'bun must not use a proxy in dev', 2026-07-12). This dev machine sets HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:2080; Bun's fetch honors it and routes same-machine 127.0.0.1 requests through the proxy -> ECONNRESET/502, breaking the loopback file-browse server (FB-D2) and its tests. Bun does NOT override env vars already present in the environment from a .env file, so a committed .env is ineffective (removed). Fix is in-process: ensureLoopbackNoProxy() (server/fs-browser-server.ts) merges localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 into NO_PROXY WITHOUT touching HTTP_PROXY (external hosts / bun install keep the proxy). Called at server.ts startup (covers bun run dev/start in all modes) and in the tests; dev.bat also adds loopback to NO_PROXY for the spawned dev process tree. Verified: loopback fetch returns 200 with HTTP_PROXY still set. NOTE: the browser/webview's own proxy behavior for localhost is a separate OS/webview concern, not bun.

Favorites / bookmarks (owner req. 11, 2026-07-12). The dialog can add sources to a favorites list — folders, files, etc. A favorite is stored as {providerId, path, label, kind:'dir'|'file'} so it generalizes to non-local providers later. User adds/removes a favorite from the dialog (e.g. star/context action); the list persists (localStorage) and shows in a sidebar next to the roots; clicking a favorite jumps to that folder (or selects that file). presetsRoot seeds the list as a default favorite. Distinct from OS-provided roots (FB-D3): roots come from listRoots(), favorites are user-curated.

Menu bar spans the whole Audio form (owner req. 12, 2026-07-12, REVISES FB-D8). The classic menu bar moves from inside the content card up to the top of the Audio page, above BOTH the side panels (Presets today, others later) AND the content/tabs — i.e. it owns the full form width, like a real app menu bar. File -> Open stays. FB3.1 placed it inside the content card; FB4.1 lifts it to the page level.

Draggable + dockable window (owner req. 13-14, 2026-07-12; SUPERSEDES the plain-modal FB2.1). The file dialog stops being a pure modal. Two modes: (1) FLOATING — a window movable by dragging its title bar (position clamped to the viewport; reuse the gtrack draggable-inspector pattern if present); (2) DOCKED — snapped to an edge of the editor form (left/right/top/bottom), where the editor LAYOUT REFLOWS to give the panel its edge and the editor shrinks, with a resizer on the shared edge. Dock side + size + mode persist (localStorage). This is a real window/panel component, not q-dialog's built-in modal.

Per-type icons + colors (owner req. 16, 2026-07-12). Each supported kind gets a distinct icon AND color: gnaural / wav / flac each their own; directories and unsupported files their own too. Centralize a kind->{icon,color} map and apply it across all three views (table / list / icons). Replaces the current single 'music_note' for every supported file.

File-list panel refinements (owner 2026-07-12). (1) Table columns are resizable and persisted: name/ext/size are drag-resizable via a grip on each header's right edge (store.tableColWidths, localStorage), while the date column flex-fills the remainder. (2) The nav toolbar (Back/Refresh/Breadcrumbs) plus the view/type/hidden controls move INTO the file-list panel (FsEntryList) as a STICKY TOP toolbar that never scrolls with the list — one toolbar instead of two. (3) The filter is hidden by default and summoned only by a funnel icon on that toolbar or Ctrl-S (store.filterVisible / toggleFilter; Ctrl-S handled at the dialog root sets it visible and FsEntryList focuses it). (4) When shown, the filter sits at the BOTTOM of the list panel, sticky, not scrolling (flex layout: toolbar / scroll / filter). FsEntryList is now a self-contained store-driven panel; the dialog's own toolbar + filter rows were removed.

FB4.3 refinements (owner 2026-07-12, after verifying FB4.1/FB4.2 = 'Fixed'). (1) Collapse the five dock-mode buttons into ONE title-bar icon (showing the current mode) + a dropdown menu, to cut visual noise. (2) In the left/right (narrow-column) dock, replace the two-pane sidebar+list with a single-column ACCORDION of three sections in this order: 'File list' (sectionFiles, default-open, flex-grows) / 'Locations' (roots) / 'Favorites'. Every other mode (floating/top/bottom) keeps the two-pane sidebar+list. The file listing was extracted into FsEntryList.vue so it is reused verbatim in both layouts (no duplication).

Remote / DB / web providers dropped from the plan (owner req. 15, 2026-07-12). Explicitly removed from scope — no steps planned. The FileSourceProvider adapter architecture (FB-D1) is LEFT INTACT precisely because it still allows adding them later (a new provider id behind the same UI) without a rewrite; this decision just records that we are not building them now.

Tree view = a fourth view mode (owner req. 17, 2026-07-13). 'tree' joins table/list/icons in FsViewMode + the view-toggle (icon account_tree), persisted like the others. Implemented with Quasar q-tree LAZY-LOAD: root nodes = provider listRoots(); expanding a dir fires @lazy-load which calls a new store.listChildren(path) (lists a dir WITHOUT mutating currentPath, honoring showHidden) and returns dirs + type-filtered files as child nodes (dirs get lazy:true). The quick regexp filter reuses q-tree's built-in :filter + :filter-method backed by store.fsNameMatches (same regexp-then-substring semantics as the flat list). Toggling showHidden/typeFilter rebuilds the tree (collapses). Selecting a file node emits select; dblclick/Enter activates (open); dblclick on a dir toggles its expansion. entryVisual() was refactored to (isDir, ext) so both flat rows and tree nodes share one icon+color map. Tree state (nodes/expanded) is local to FsEntryList (view-specific), not persisted; only the mode value is.

Persist the dialog's open state across restarts (owner req. 18, 2026-07-13). windowMode/dockSize/floatRect already persisted (FB-D13), but the open/closed flag lived in AudioPage as a transient ref, so a docked panel never reappeared after a program restart. Fix: the open flag moves into the fs-browser store as a persisted field (localStorage key ...-open), and AudioPage binds its v-model to store.open. On next launch, if it was open, FileOpenDialog mounts with modelValue true, runs init() (loopback discovery + start dir), and restores at the persisted mode+geometry — a docked panel comes back on its edge, a floating one at its saved rect. Scope note: the dialog belongs to the Audio form, so 'program open' = arriving on the Audio page (where the panel lives).
